title: Raisin Irish Pudding
description: A Japanese-inspired dessert with a unique twist from traditional ingredients.
instructions: 2. Cut the Irish raisin bread into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet.
3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
4. In a separate bowl, mix together the pudding mix and Jgoozy syrup.
5. Add the sugar and mix until dissolved.
6. Pour the pudding mixture over the toasted bread cubes.
7. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until chilled.
